newsitem.title: CHINA: China produces 1.0 billion tonnes coal in Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: China produces 1.0 billion tonnes coal in Jan-Sept.

text.p: China produced 1.01 billion tonnes of raw coal in the first three quarters of this year, 75 million tonnes more than in the same period of 1995, the official Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
Coal output exceeded increased demand on the domestic market, the agency said without giving details.

Coal stocks across the country rose to 192 million tonnes by the end of September, 30 million tonnes more than at the beginning of the year, it quoted Ye Qing, vice minister of the State Planning Commission as saying.
China's coal industry would maintain rapid growth in 1997 and could satisfy domestic demand that was expected to grow 45 million tonnes year-on-year, Xinhua said.
